title: Governing AI at Scale: Rogers' Enterprise AI Evaluation and Governance System
audience: Executive leadership, enterprise architecture, and technology strategy team
objective: Secure executive sponsorship and investment for a centralized AI Agent Governance, Evaluation, and Monitoring Platform that eliminates agent sprawl, enforces quality standards, and enables responsible AI scaling across Rogers Communications.
key_messages: Rogers has deployed AI agents across business units with zero centralized oversight — creating compounding risk in quality, compliance, security, and cost
A centralized AI Governance and Evaluation Platform is the foundational capability Rogers needs to validate, catalog, and monitor every agent before and after deployment
A five-dimension evaluation scorecard (accuracy, relevance, reliability, safety, performance) creates a universal quality standard applicable to every agent type
A three-tier governance hierarchy — strategic, operational, and technical — defines accountability, policy enforcement, and audit controls at every level
A phased 12-month implementation roadmap delivers measurable ROI: reduced duplication, faster validation, improved compliance posture, and lower operational risk
additional_context: The proposed Enterprise AI Evaluation and Governance Platform serves as the control plane for all AI agents and intelligent applications across Rogers. The platform establishes standardized lifecycle governance, centralized evaluation frameworks, automated testing, model and agent registration, performance monitoring, auditability, and executive reporting. This capability will allow Rogers to confidently scale AI across the organization while maintaining compliance, reducing risk, eliminating redundant investments, accelerating deployment readiness, and creating measurable accountability for AI outcomes
